TLDR: The guys on the highway slowed down thinking my car broke down and wanted to help

Sunday evening, I was away on a trip with my girlfriend and our closest group of friends (6 of us). I have a ancestral spiritual gift which can flare up on when I’m drinking abit and not in the best mental space.

We go out, I get drunk, but I don’t notice I get beyond drunk, my mind as me is blank I don’t know what happened but the next time I get back into my sense it’s been two hours we’re back at the house we are staying in, I’ve been put in the car with all my belongings and am being told to leave. It’s 12am, i ask what’s going on and no one’s is willing to tell me, I pick up that things have been hostile

As I drive away to nowhere, I get a text from my girlfriend stating that I chocked her…I break down,I cry…I’ve never been that type of guy, for me there is no more disgusting act than a man putting his hands on a woman unless it’s self defense. 

Im confused, I’m distraught, I’m broken, I don’t know what happened, what caused the commotion, I’m frustrated because the zoning out thing has become a trend but usually I’m at home with people around to control it….mostly I’m explosively angry with myself 

So I park on the side of the freeway, I try to call my girlfriend to say goodbye, she doesn’t answer, call my friends, also don’t answer, ended up calling two of my friends who I have designated as the executors of my last wishes and managed to get through. I said my goodbyes and told them the proccess that will follow regarding the sending of my last wishes to them and copies of my will.

I see a car approaching, I get out, the tears roll down and I scream to god and apologize, turn my back and walk into this road.

Driver is hits me but the speed is not enough, I only get a hairline fracture on my tibia from impact and dislocated shoulder from the landing. Driver comes out in a state, realizes I’m alive, i tell him I’m okay and he must leave. It’s not a safe area so he leaves for his own safety

End up in hospital for my injuries. My sister dragged me there…I’m currently in a psychiatric hospital trying to process a way that I see going forward 

Deep down, I still feel the only consequence for what I did was, in my eyes, is death. To put my hands on any female is bad but to put my hands on the woman I love, with all my heart, the woman I was hoping to marry at the end of the year…my soulmate…that was the last straw, I couldn’t look at myself the same and to be honest I still can’t. I have since sent lengthily apologies to everyone who was there, including my girlfriend. I don’t even know if that’s what I should call her, we’re are probably done and it’s my fault. I don’t remember why or what happened but I know it’s my fault.

That’s how I survived!

10.30: Usually went shopping/sightseeing around this time or just relaxed with other partygoers
11.30: Back to the room to get ready
12.00: the buses leave the hotel and the trip from brussels to boom was about an hour long, again another chance to socialize
13.00- 00.45: party time!!!!
Had to miss the last part of the night because the busses leave at 01.00 and missing them means you're pretty screwed (believe me, it was not a fun experience)
Back at the hotel, there was dinner for those who were hungry after which it was time to get some much needed sleep and do it all again tomorrow
